summary: Frontend-only testing of /netapp-portfolio v3 polish pass. All 8 requested feature groups verified at 1920x900. Hero slider (4 slides, stats, dots, prev/next, 7s auto-rotation with pause-on-hover), filter bar (chips filter + count update + reset + empty state for UNIFIED+SANTRICITY), 26 model cards (tilt CSS vars on hover), 4 family-guide cards with animated bars (widths 17–89px post-reveal), OS compare (ontap/santricity + .npv2-osc__vs badge + 11 comparison rows), 8-question configurator reaching result with model/CTA, back/restart functional, summary section with 3 equal-height axis cards (343px). Zero console errors.

issues: Spec mentions '.np-hs__mirror img' for reflection but DOM has 0 elements with that class — reflection is instead rendered via a second inside .np-hs__slab (each slide has 2 slab imgs). Visually correct (reflection renders under chassis), but note mismatch between spec selector naming and actual implementation. Non-blocking.

Spec references 'table with 10 rows' but OSC is implemented as div-based rows (.npv2-osc__row), not a <table>; observed 11 row elements (likely 1 header + 10 data). Non-blocking — selectors in request were descriptive.

critical_code_review_comments: NetAppPortfolioPage.jsx is 1265 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting HeroSlider, ModelCard, FamilyGuideSection, OSCompareSection, NetAppConfigurator into separate files/modules.

HeroSlider auto-rotation pauses while mouse is over the hero (expected UX); initial playwright run with default mouse at viewport center kept it paused — add note for future testing agents to move mouse away before timing rotation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero slider auto-rotation (7s) only runs when mouse is NOT hovering .np-hs — in Playwright move mouse to (10,10) before measuring rotation. Cookie banner 'Akceptuj wszystkie' must be accepted first. Configurator has 8 questions; last option-click produces [data-testid=npv2-cfg-result] with CTA npv2-cfg-cta-contact. OSC rows are divs, not <tr>.
